entries.title: Card charts show boxes when you may pick several options
entries.body: When a card weighs a question's options on a chart and lets you pick more than one, each option now shows a square box that fills with a check, as any checkbox list does. Before, every option showed a round ring, so the question looked like a single pick.

picture.alt: A decision card with three options on small radar charts, the first two ticked with filled square boxes and the third an empty box
